subject: Re: SLA credits, on-call surcharge & committed uptime tiers
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@skycore.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@skycore.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SLA credits and on-call surcharge for 99.9% commit

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers look promising for our inference-heavy pipelines. Procurement is asking for clarity on two items before we move to signature:

1) Uptime tiers & credit calculation: Skycore typically buys 99.9% commit for mission-critical paths. We need explicit credit slabs and an example calculation for a monthly outage scenario.

2) On-call surcharge: our legal team flagged the optional on-call rapid-response add-on (30 min dev response) — please confirm the monthly surcharge and whether it applies pro rata during trial months.

Can you send a short appendix or table we can attach to the PO? We plan to present to our CFO on Monday.

Appreciate it —
Alyssa Turner
Director of Cloud Platform
Skycore AI

Attachments: Skycore-Procurement-Form.pdf (attached)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@skycore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA credits and on-call surcharge for 99.9% commit

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks and the procurement form. I've sketched an appendix for the 99.9% commit and the optional on-call add-on; attaching it here for your CFO. Key points up front:

- Uptime tiers we recommend: 99.5% (standard), 99.9% (enterprise), 99.95% (premium). Credit slabs: 5% monthly credit for <99.9%, 10% for <99.5%, 20% for <99.0%. Example calculation included on page 2.

- Calculation note: credits are computed on monthly invoice net of usage credits; example: for a $50k invoice, 5% credit = $2,500. We include how incident windows are aggregated across the month.

- On-call surcharge: $6,500/month for 24/7 rapid-response (30-min acknowledgement, 2-hour mitigation SLA). During trial/prorated months we bill pro rata to the day. We can also offer a reduced onboarding month rate of $3,250 if you commit to a 12-month contract.

- Concessions: for deals >= $200k ARR we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to one month of the selected plan (applied at invoice after go-live).

I've attached: SI-Redwood-SLA-Appendix.pdf and Redwood-Support-Price-Grid.xlsx. If procurement wants a redline, Ben can handle the language tweaks to the appendix.

Next step: if that aligns, I can upload a redline-ready DocuSign and loop in your procurement contact.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SI-Redwood-SLA-Appendix.pdf, Redwood-Support-Price-Grid.xlsx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SLA credits and on-call surcharge for 99.9% commit

Ben / Monica — quick FYI and request for sign-off. Skycore is asking for the SLA appendix + explicit pro rata language for the on-call add-on. I proposed the $6.5k/month and a 50% onboarding concession for 12-month commits.

Can you confirm we're comfortable with the credit slabs and the example calc on page 2? If yes, I'll push the DocuSign today and try to get procurement to take the onboarding credit as an amendment (reduces negotiation overhead).

Thanks —
Rachel

Subject: Re: SLA credits and on-call surcharge for 99.9% commit

Hi Rachel — thanks for the appendix and quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from legal/procurement before we can accept: 

1) Credit slab tweak: legal wants the 5% credit to apply for availability <99.9% but >=99.5%; anything <99.5% should escalate to a 12% credit (rather than 10%) to better align with our internal SLAs. Can you confirm?

2) On-call surcharge proration: procurement requests that the onboarding concession (50% onboarding month) be applied as a credit on the first invoice rather than an amendment to the MSA. They also want a cap that the onboarding credit cannot exceed one month's invoice.

3) DocuSign: please send the redline-ready appendix as a separate attachment and include the full PO number field. We provided our procurement form (attached).

If we can get those two small changes, procurement can approve and route to CFO for signature.

Regards,
Skycore Procurement Team
procurement@skycore.ai

Attachments: Skycore-Procurement-Form.pdf (resubmitted with PO#)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA credits and on-call surcharge for 99.9% commit

Thanks — we can accept the procurement changes with the following confirmed language: 

- Credit slabs updated: 5% credit for availability <99.9% and >=99.5%; 12% credit for availability <99.5% and >=99.0%; 20% for <99.0% (no change). Example calc updated in page 2.
- Onboarding concession: 50% onboarding month credit to be applied to the first invoice post-go-live; credit capped at one month of that invoice.

Ben has approved the wording and Monica will run a final legal/ops check on the redline. I will package the redline-ready appendix and send a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow, and include a PO# field per your form.

Alyssa — once you confirm the PO# and return the signed form, we will get provisioning scheduled.

Best,
Rachel Kim
